Airway careAbout this site

Preparation before airway suction

Assess breathing pattern, oxygen saturation, patient cooperation, and the indication for suction before equipment is opened.

Critical warning

Stop preparation and call for help if oxygen saturation falls below the locally prescribed limit.

Equipment checklist

  • Working suction unit with prescribed pressure range.
  • Correct catheter size and sterile gloves when required.
  • Oxygen and ventilation equipment available at bedside.
Preparation checks
CheckRequired action
PressureVerify prescribed range before patient contact.
MonitoringPulse oximetry must be visible during the procedure.
